source.ref: src/components/Home.tsx (gym-app repository, main at f046ac0), WeeklyStat and WeeklyAverages

observation: Our Home component renders two cards, 'Avg sleep this week' ('per night') and 'Avg calories this week' ('kcal per day'). With no data this week the value is a dash. When a change exists, it shows the absolute change with '+' (class 'up') for an increase, '−' (class 'down') for a decrease and '±' (class 'same') when the absolute change is below 0.005; the class depends only on the sign of the change, for both sleep and calories. No percentage, arrow, or count of days averaged is shown.
limitations: Source code read at one commit; not observed in a browser. Colours come from CSS (see E-012).
